abstract: Dispatches coding work to resident ACP workers over a loopback WebSocket through the acpw CLI. Grok runs natively via grok agent serve; Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor are bridged from stdio ACP onto the same URL. The host agent keeps planning, scoping, and verification; workers only execute. Every command prints one JSON line, and an ok result means the ACP turn ended, not that the task is correct.
